pathAssistantSteps.info: Individual has an open opportunity. Check with Opportunity Owner whether you can engage Contact

Individual is new a New Contact

  • Check whether the contact was converted from a Lead
  • Set status to Working if you're looking to engage the indvidual

Contact is being engaged by Marketing. 

  • Once Lead Score passes threshold, Salesforce will notify Contact Owner
  • You can progress the Contact to Working if you wish to engage

Contact is being worked by Sales

  • Once you have booked a demo in with this contact, create an Opportunity. Opening an Opportunity will automatically change the stage to "Active Opp"
  • No activity against the Contact will move the Status to Nurturing
